name: LLM-agent-driven capability development and evasion testing
description: Where a threat actor runs a fleet of AI coding agents in an automated build–test–iterate loop — ingesting public offensive-security research, mapping it to MITRE ATT&CK, generating payloads, and empirically testing them against live EDR/AV products in a controlled lab — in order to mass-produce and validate evasion capability before operational use. Distinct from LLM-aided development (a single artifact, human-driven) and from LLM-orchestrated operations (where the agent executes the intrusion itself): here the agents build and validate the toolkit, and humans run the intrusion. Maps to T1587.
